text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ, huh...
It has a truly unique atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, that is not an issue. Though it was all dirt,
the mile was a distance I ran frequently at Kasamatsu.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I like short distances.
I don't have to worry about a thing—I can just run.
